title: Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity
summary: Feedback centers on Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, with positive comments about ease and confidence in use but negative and mixed comments focused on glitchy behavior, wireless connection loss, and re-pairing issues, while many fragments only mention the feature without clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise comfortable, confident use of Apple CarPlay and strong satisfaction with Android Auto.

negative.summary: Negative reviews express dissatisfaction with Apple CarPlay, but concrete examples are limited in the sampled fragments.

mixed.summary: Mixed reviews describe intermittent or context-specific connectivity problems such as glitchy CarPlay, occasional failure to connect, frequent wireless dropouts, and needing to re-pair phones after switching drivers.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mainly mention CarPlay or Android Auto presence or connectivity behavior without enough context to tell whether the experience is favorable or unfavorable.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are short labels or issue codes rather than full customer explanations, which limits detail about the exact failure mode or user impact.
A large share of the topic is undetermined, so the examples do not provide a complete picture of sentiment.
Some negative and mixed assignments rely on sparse fragments with little descriptive text, so examples are insufficient to fully summarize all complaints.
